name: Austin ISD Summer Internship Program
org: Austin ISD with Austin Ed Fund and the Austin Chamber of Commerce
what_you_do: Work at a business or community partner for 6 weeks, about 20 hours a week. Students are placed by their interests and what is open.
who_can_apply: Austin ISD students who will be in grades 10 to 12.
duration: 6 weeks, about 20 hours a week (2026: June 8 to July 23, with a break June 29 to July 3)
deadline_text: The 2026 interest form closed Feb 6, 2026. A banner on the page says 2027 details are coming and the student form opens in December (year not stated, so confirm).
how_to_apply: Fill out the Student Interest Form linked on the program page. Students heard by March 30. They had to go to orientations in late April and mid May. Contact Cecilia Gutierrez at cecilia.gutierrez@austinisd.org.
notes: Info sessions in 2026 were held on Google Meet in December and January. The page lists the work period as ending July 23 in one place and July 24 in another.
